# SkillInf — llms.txt
# This file provides context for AI language models about SkillInf.

## About
SkillInf (https://www.skillinf.in) is an online internship platform that offers
free virtual internship programs for students in India across technology domains
including Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Full-Stack Web Development,
Data Science & Analytics, Cybersecurity, Python Development, UI/UX Design, and
Cloud Computing.

## What SkillInf Does
- Provides structured 4-week virtual internship programs
- Students complete hands-on project tasks each week
- Issues verifiable digital internship completion certificates
- Physical certificates available as a separate service
- LinkedIn verification required to unlock course steps

## Key Facts
- Internship enrollment: Free
- Certificate: Paid (digital and physical options)
- Duration: 4 weeks (project-based)
- Mode: 100% online / remote
- Target audience: College students and recent graduates in India
- Support email: support@skillinf.in
- Phone: +91 93426 37290 / +91 99946 11054
- Website: https://www.skillinf.in

Cybersecurity, Python Development, UI/UX Design, Cloud Computing, and more.
